The problem

Critical technology chains are difficult to understand and verify. Sources, companies, bottlenecks and analyst judgements are scattered, and practitioners lack a simple way to correct the record.

What it does

An open research map joining bottlenecks, producers, science, policy, capital and talent, with evidence links, visual exploration, searchable explanations and a dedicated content contribution inbox.

Where it is heading

A collaborative research service where anyone can follow a technology chain, inspect the evidence behind a claim, personalise their learning and contribute expertise that improves a shared public map.

Being built now
  • Keep development and public profiles current
  • Make Substrata a useful research companion
  • Enrich company, science and talent research
  • Explore technology chains with checkable visuals
